strings.Adaptivní interval – při dlouhém klidu (: Adaptive interval – slow down reading during long idle periods (no subtitles) to save CPU
strings.Auto = izolace bílého textu, při slabém: Auto = isolate white text, compare with the original image if the result is weak
strings.Citlivost: nižší = chytá i šedší text (v: Sensitivity: lower = also catches grayer text (more noise)
strings.Click-through (klik prochází skrz overla: Click-through (clicks pass through the overlay into the game)
strings.Co se překládá (přepnutí také zkratkou,: What gets translated (also switchable by hotkey, default F7)
strings.DeepL – API klíč (Free končí na :fx → ap: DeepL – API key (Free keys end with :fx → api-free.deepl.com, otherwise api.deepl.com)
strings.Delší čtení a texty plné čísel (panely s: Long readings and texts full of numbers (FPS or stats panels) are treated as UI, not subtitles, and are not translated.
strings.Google Translate bez klíče používá NEOFI: Google Translate without a key uses an UNOFFICIAL public endpoint (translate.googleapis.com, client=gtx). It is not an official API, has no guarantee of working, and Google may restrict or change it at any time. For reliable use, consider the official Google Cloud API or DeepL with a key.
strings.Hodí se pro UI texty, které nechcete pře: Useful for UI texts you do not want translated (phone, clock, menu names). Applies to both modes.
strings.Ignorovat řádky obsahující (oddělte stře: Ignore lines containing (separate with semicolons), e.g. Unknown; Call; Snapmatic:
strings.Jazyk titulků ve hře (čtení OCR) → jazyk: Subtitle language in the game (OCR) → translation language:
strings.Každý anglický text se přeloží a zobrazí: Every source text is translated and shown directly over the original. More CPU-heavy, interval at least 0.7 s.
strings.Klikněte do políčka a stiskněte novou ko: Click a field and press a new key combination (e.g. F8 or Ctrl+Shift+T). Backspace = restore default. Applied after “Save and apply”. Hotkeys are global (they also work inside the game).
strings.Klíče se ukládají šifrovaně přes Windows: Keys are stored encrypted via Windows DPAPI (bound to your account) and are never written to logs.
strings.Min. počet písmen titulku:: Min. number of letters in a subtitle:

strings.OBS Browser Source (překlad do streamu b: OBS Browser Source (translation for streaming without screen capture)
strings.Oblast se ukládá jako zlomek obrazu, tak: The area is stored as a fraction of the image, so it works at any resolution. You can change it at any time, even while translating.
strings.Oblast titulků (platí pro režim „Jen kon: Subtitle area (applies to “Conversation only”; “Everything on screen” reads the whole image):
strings.Odstraňovat typické OCR smetí (samostatn: Remove typical OCR junk (stray symbols, “oo:c” etc.) before translating
strings.Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1, LM St: Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1, LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1. A local model sends nothing to the internet. Speed and quality depend on the model; AI translation is usually slower than Google, so try a smaller model.
strings.Opakování po síťové chybě / chybě server: Retries after a network / server error (0–3):
strings.Po spuštění aplikace rovnou spustit přek: Start translating right after the app launches
strings.Podrobný log (každé čtení OCR, rozhodnut: Verbose log (every OCR read, duplicate decisions, delay until display) – useful for debugging
strings.Pomocný druhý OCR engine Tesseract při s: Use the Tesseract helper OCR engine for weak readings (only if installed)
strings.Posílat předchozí titulky jako kontext (: Send previous subtitles as context (used by DeepL; Google ignores it)
strings.Pozor: u Gemini a placených AI se text t: Note: with Gemini and paid AI services the subtitle text is sent to the provider. Usage may be charged.
strings.Počítat oblast uvnitř obrazu hry (automa: Measure the area inside the game image (automatically crops black bars around the picture)
A profile saves everything except API keys – e.g. different settings for a game and for a movie.
strings.Překladač (žádné automatické přepínání –: Translator (no automatic switching – if it fails, you will see the error):

strings.Přesnost OCR na přibalených testovacích: OCR accuracy on the bundled test images
strings.Skrýt overlay před záchytem obrazovky (z: Hide the overlay before screen capture (on = you will NOT see it in OBS; turn off if you want to stream it)
strings.Slovník jmen a frází (jeden na řádek):: Glossary of names and phrases (one per line):
strings.Spustit překlad automaticky, když se obj: Start translating automatically when the selected program appears (source “Program”)
strings.Titulky dole uprostřed obrazovky (oblast: Subtitles at the bottom center of the screen (area from Area selection). The translation appears right above the original. Lightest on CPU.
strings.Umístit overlay automaticky NAD původní: Place the overlay automatically ABOVE the original subtitles (turns off after a manual move)
strings.Upravit polohu a velikost overlaye myší: Adjust overlay position and size with the mouse
strings.V OBS: Zdroje → + → Prohlížeč, vložte ad: In OBS: Sources → + → Browser, paste the address, width 1920 and height 1080. Style can be changed with parameters, e.g. ?size=44&color=ffff00&english=1
strings.Vyšší = méně chybných zobrazení, ale pom: Higher = fewer false displays, but slower reaction
strings.Vše na obrazovce: min. interval OCR (ms): Everything on screen: min. OCR interval (ms):
strings.Vše na obrazovce: velikost písma (× výšk: Everything on screen: font size (× line height):
strings.Zachytávání okna – vyberete konkrétní ok: Capture a window – pick a specific window from the list
strings.Zachytávání programu – podle názvu proce: Capture a program – by process name, reconnects after the game restarts
strings.Zakrýt původní titulky: překlad se zobra: Cover original subtitles: the translation is shown DIRECTLY OVER the original on an opaque black background (original not visible). Off = the translation is above the original and the original stays visible.
strings.Změna jazyka titulků (OCR) se projeví po: Changing the subtitle (OCR) language takes effect after restarting the app and requires the Windows OCR language pack to be installed. DeepL does not support every language (Hindi, Hebrew, Thai, Vietnamese) – use Google.
strings.Zobrazit anglický originál nad českým př: Show the original text above the translation
strings.chyba klíče / limitu se neopakuje; překl: key / quota errors are not retried; the translator never switches by itself
strings.„Vice City“ = nepřekládat. „jackpot = vý: “Vice City” = do not translate. “jackpot = win” = always translate like this. Lines starting with # are comments.
strings.🖱 Graficky nastavit čtení i umístění př: 🖱  Set reading and translation placement graphically…
strings.Další jazyky stačí přidat jako soubor do: More languages can be added just by dropping a file into the Languages folder (see Languages/README.md). Translation corrections are welcome.
strings.Program funguje s tím, co už Windows obs: The program works with what Windows already includes. Below is what you may need to install, plus links for optional features. Each item shows whether your computer already has it.
strings.Potřebuje ho samotný program (pokud ho s: The program itself needs it (if you can run it, it is already installed).
strings.Nastavení → Čas a jazyk → Jazyk a oblast: Settings → Time & language → Language & region → Add a language (enable “Optical character recognition”). Or use a command in PowerShell as administrator – the button below copies it. For a subtitle language other than English, change the language code in the command (e.g. ja-JP).
strings.Volitelné – lepší čtení a záznamová kart: Optional – better reading and capture card
strings.Pomůže u špatně čitelných titulků. Po in: Helps with hard-to-read subtitles. The program finds it by itself after installation (or enter the path in the OCR tab).
strings.Pokud hrajete z konzole přes záznamovou: If you play from a console through a capture card, the program finds it automatically. You choose the “Capture card” source in the Image source tab.
strings.Bez klíče funguje neoficiální Google Tra: Without a key the unofficial Google Translate works. For more stable or better translation you can create a key; paste it in the Translation tab.
strings.Klíč vytvoříte v Google AI Studio tlačít: Create the key in Google AI Studio with the Create API key button. Subtitle text is sent to Google and usage may be charged.
strings.Zvolte plán DeepL API (Free: 500 000 zna: Choose a DeepL API plan (Free: 500,000 characters per month). A “DeepL Translator” subscription does not include an API key. Free keys end with :fx.
strings.Vyžaduje Google Cloud projekt, zapnuté C: Requires a Google Cloud project with Cloud Translation API and billing enabled. The key is created under Credentials.
strings.Pro AI překlad přes OpenAI-kompatibilní: For AI translation via an OpenAI-compatible server: address https://api.openai.com/v1.
strings.Jedna adresa pro mnoho modelů: https://o: One address for many models: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
strings.Po instalaci stáhněte menší model a v zá: After installing, download a smaller model and in the Translation tab choose AI via OpenAI-compatible server (address http://localhost:11434/v1).
strings.Grafická aplikace pro lokální modely; za: Graphical app for local models; enable its local server (address http://localhost:1234/v1).
